title: Share the Config
goal: Three owners of one theme string - without copying it and without moving it away.
hints: Moving theme into ui leaves nothing for audio - Rc solves this by counting owners, not copying data.
theme.clone() works but reads like a deep copy. Rc::clone(&theme) says out loud: this is a counter bump.
explanation: Rc means shared ownership: each Rc::clone(&theme) bumps a counter - all three handles point at ONE String, dropped when the last owner goes. Moving theme breaks the later handles (E0382). The method-call spelling theme.clone() does the identical cheap thing, but reads like an expensive deep clone - Clippy's clone_on_ref_ptr pushes toward the prefix form precisely so readers can trust that .clone() means real copying. Same machine, honest syntax.
